page.overview:
Who is Rus Livingston?

Unnamed Astronauts Sequids (involuntarily)

Invincible (involuntarily, killer) Martians

Rus Livingston is a minor character in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 to 4. He was one of the first four human astronauts sent to Mars, with Invincible shadowing the mission.

During the expedition, Rus became the host of the Sequids. A Martians native took his place on Earth to prevent the infection from spreading, living under his identity and even acting as a superhero.
